evidence: The film was annealed at 850 °C for 30 min under nitrogen at a pressure of 300 mTorr. The scan shows a very smooth film. The rms roughness of the film was determined to be 0.17 nm, which is approximately the same as that of the bare substrate. The glancing angle X-ray diffraction (XRD) taken of the same substrate indicates an amorphous film for both the low and high temperature anneals.
